column1: # Exceptions for scripts/check_doc_commands.sh: FILE <TAB> REFERENCE <TAB> REASON.
# Only two shapes belong here, and both must be visible to a reader of the
# document itself -- an allowlist entry is not a way to leave a command that
#   1. a HISTORICAL command, where the prose says the thing is gone
#   2. a reference the READER is told to create locally
# Anything else is drift and should be fixed in the document.
# For shape 1 the REFERENCE column may be the bare runner (`just`), which
# excuses that runner for the whole file. Use it only where the file itself
# says up front that none of its commands run -- the two dead bench READMEs --
# never to quiet a document that still reads as current.
